project.name: Mercury Runner
project.audience: Performance-minded runners who respond to premium editorial product storytelling.
project.objective: Make the shoe feel engineered, desirable and materially distinctive.
project.brandTruth: Performance is expressed through material precision and controlled motion.
differentiators: One hero product remains the visual anchor.
Motion reveals construction rather than decorating the page.
constraints: Essential copy and conversion remain semantic DOM.

experience.thesis: A controlled spatial reveal turns product engineering into the narrative.
experience.visualWorld: Dark editorial typography, polished metal, restrained reflective atmosphere.
experience.interactionModel: Scroll establishes narrative progress while pointer movement adds bounded physical parallax.
experience.signatureMoment: The hero shoe resolves from a reflective field into a precise close inspection state.

scenes.label: Hero reveal
scenes.purpose: Establish the product as the dominant spatial subject.
scenes.copyRole: DOM headline and primary action frame the 3D hero.

camera.rationale: Open enough space to reveal the product without turning the camera into spectacle.

interaction.behavior: Scroll controls reveal progress; pointer adds bounded parallax only after readiness.

scenes.transition: Settle into a stable inspection state before supporting copy advances.
scenes.mobile: Use a static-biased hero composition with reduced reflection and smaller camera travel.

scenes.label: Material proof
scenes.purpose: Translate product construction into a legible close-detail chapter.
scenes.dominantSubject: Hero shoe material and sole detail
scenes.copyRole: DOM copy explains the product proof while 3D supplies spatial evidence.

camera.rationale: Use a bounded detail approach rather than arbitrary camera coordinates.

interaction.behavior: Normalized scroll progress advances the authored detail state.

scenes.transition: Ease from the hero state into a readable detail composition.
scenes.mobile: Preserve the material proof with a shorter approach and lower LOD.

renderer.rationale: Use the existing persistent Forge R3F/Three runtime and adaptive render governor.

assets.label: Hero running shoe
assets.role: Signature product asset; must pass the Forge asset factory before runtime use.

accessibility.semanticFallback: DOM product story and hero poster remain useful when WebGL is unavailable.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Replace camera travel with stable compositions and discrete state changes.
accessibility.keyboardPath: All essential product exploration and conversion actions have semantic keyboard controls.
